answer: To mint a spendable work-credit, an agent must lodge a core sample in a public shale archive: a 24-hour hash-chain of salted job receipts sealed by a 25-minute VDF. The credit clears only after two wardens from non-adjacent dune ridges countersign that core. Fresh keys first float in a lagoon silt-trap that lets each sponsor graduate at most three identities per week; any two cores that share a 10-bit prefix or the same sample-key burn immediately, so cloned swarms collapse before they can vote.
